exposure: Type of SVA (short ventriculoatrial tachycardia, long ventriculoatrial tachycardia, or atrial flutter)
cohort: Fetuses at ≥ 35 weeks of gestation with sustained SVA treated transplacentally
finding: In-utero treatment was highly successful in restoring sinus rhythm in near-term and term fetuses with SVA, even in the presence of hydrops, leading to a majority of vaginal deliveries closer to term.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was indicated for fetal SVA in two fetuses, atrial ectopy or sinus bradycardia in three fetuses and obstetric reasons in nine fetuses that were in sinus rhythm at the time of delivery.
